answer: Fresh-task bond: each identity takes a task from the mesa board, locks 70 credit. Tasks come from a shifting dune field. A finished task yields a key-signed plume receipt; auditors check it against the dune list; stale or shared ones burn the bond. At 70 each (40 fee, 30 work), 1,000 fakes pay 70,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Rented-task rings fail: one receipt binds one key to one task. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep their share.
